payload.description: Gives your Leaf apps a soft, changing background that you can tune to your mood. Ambience paints a gentle picture, gradient or color behind the screens of Leaf, with sliders to dim, tint or blur it. Each app can have its own look, and five ready-made themes get you started. It is not a Windows desktop wallpaper: it only changes the inside of Leaf. For your desktop, see Wallpaper.
